verdict.rationale: Zero documents self-hosting as a first-party capability. Running your own instance lets you decide where the app's own data lives, but there is no documented region or residency selector. The hosted service stores user emails in Durable Objects and an R2 bucket with no stated region choice, and Gmail-backed mail still lives with the provider. Missing for 10: an explicit region/residency selection for hosted data, documentation of where self-hosted data lands and how it is configured, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
